from pathlib import Path

from cyclopts import App, Parameter
from cyclopts.config import Toml

app = App(
    name="mycli",
    config=Toml(
        Path("pyproject.toml"),
        root_keys=["tool", "mycli"],
        must_exist=False,
    ),
)


@app.command
def run(
    host: str = "localhost",
    port: int = 8000,
    debug: bool = False,
):
    """Run the application.

    Parameters
    ----------
    host: str
        Host to bind to.
    port: int
        Port to listen on.
    debug: bool
        Enable debug mode.
    """
    print(f"host={host!r} port={port!r} debug={debug!r}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
